title: Wrapper follows a run before exit
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with at least one work tape, and let $\mathrm{entry}$ and $\mathrm{exit}$ be states of $C$. For any Boolean input $x$, any configuration $c$ of $C$ on input $x$, and any natural number $t$, suppose that for every $j<t$ the configuration reached from $c$ after $j$ steps is not in state $\mathrm{exit}$. Then the wrapper run for $t$ steps from the state-renamed copy of $c$ equals the state-renamed configuration reached by $C$ after $t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$C$ has at least one work tape
entry and exit are states of $C$
$c$ is a configuration of $C$ on input $x$
For every $j<t$, the run from $c$ at time $j$ is not in state exit
replaced:
As long as the inner machine's run from a configuration has not reached the
designated exit state, the decider wrapper's run from the state-renamed copy of
that configuration coincides, under the renaming, with the inner machine's run.
